title: Band breaks up after the Canary Cottage; Jelly Roll in Oakland
summary: Lester Mapp lures away Slocum and the pianist, Jelly Roll joins the band at an Oakland basement club, and Reb and Johnny go home to open a music store.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: No. No, it wasn't no American. It was Mexican, and they was fighting amongst themselves, I think. I don't know whether it was part of Villa's gang or not. I don't remember now what it was all about. And so we all went...worked out on the beach in...in San Francisco--Canary Cottage. Then, after that, after that contract finished, Lester Mapp that we had started from, opened a big place, and he persuaded Slocum--or Mitchell--with the clarinet and, I think, the piano player and...to go back with him. That kind of busted up our bank [band ], and that time we got Jelly Roll to play the piano, and Wells and I and the drummer, and we went over to Oakland and worked in a...in a...a basement nightclub, I think, called The Hofbrau or something. And this was about '19, and Jelly Roll was playing there...played piano with us, and when that engagement ended, why I...my brother and I came home. He was playing at another nightclub in Oakland called Ritchie--Ritchie's Nightclub. Ritchie was a singer, and...Cliff Ritchie. And we came home, and we opened the music store, and the rest of the band broke up. They scattered, you know, after that but we...my brother and I came home with Syd Carter that I told you was with the medicine show for many years, and we opened the music store.
